name: cmr-bun-bench
description: Benchmark handlers for the CMR-vs-layer Bun runtime comparison. @aws-sdk/client-s3 is bundled into the aws-sdk handler variant at build time; @beesolve/lambda-bun-runtime is installed only to source the prebuilt Bun layer zip (dist/bun-lambda-layer-*.zip) — its code is never bundled into a handler.
